claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with current settings, targeting tidal volume 6 mL/kg predicted body weight and monitoring plateau pressures (currently 35 cmH2O).
Titrate inspired oxygen and PEEP to maintain SpO2 92-96% and avoid hyperoxia, given PaO2 200-207 mmHg on FiO2 50% and PEEP 13 cmH2O.

Continue lung-protective ventilation with low tidal volumes and consider further PEEP optimization or recruitment maneuvers if oxygenation deteriorates, monitoring plateau pressure and driving pressure.
Continue insulin infusion (currently ~2 units/hour) with hourly glucose monitoring and titration to target glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Administer sliding-scale or correction insulin as needed for hyperglycemia (glucose 359-525 mg/dL) while transitioning from IV to subcutaneous insulin when stable.
Obtain arterial blood gas in 4-6 hours to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation, given mixed respiratory acidosis and metabolic acidosis (pH 7.23-7.35, base excess -6 to 0).
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, phosphate, ionized calcium) and replace as needed, with potassium 3.6-4.9 mEq/L and phosphate 2.8-5 mg/dL.

Continue sedation with midazolam and fentanyl infusions, targeting Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale (RASS) 0 to -2, and assess readiness for daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (vancomycin, cefepime, azithromycin) and obtain repeat cultures if signs of infection persist, with sputum and influenza testing already collected.
Perform daily assessment of ventilator weaning parameters, including spontaneous breathing trial and readiness for extubation, given improving oxygenation and RASS -1 to 0.
